newsitem.title: UK: EU November refinery runs hit record - Euroil.
newsitem.headline: EU November refinery runs hit record - Euroil.

text.p: European Union refinery crude runs hit record levels in November, rising 6.3 per cent or 690,000 barrels a day (bpd) to 11.729 million from 11.186 million in October, Stichting Euroilstock said in a monthly report on Friday.

Refinery utilisation in the 14 European Union countries excluding Sweden climbed to 93.09 pct from 87.61 pct in October. Net refinery production rose 5.4 per cent (628,000 bpd) to 12.296 million from 11.668 million, Euroilstock said.
November crude refinery runs were 4.9 pct higher than the same time last year and utilisation was 4.3 percent higher than in November 1995.
Gasoline production was up 128,000 bpd (4.1 percent) from October at 3.281 million.
Middle distillates output was up 171,000 bpd (3.2 percent) at 5.518 million.
Fuel oil production went up 124,000 bpd (7.8 percent to 1.72 million.
Naphtha output was up 60,000 bpd (6.6 percent) to 968,000 bpd.
They are based on a nameplate capacity of 12.6 million bpd. Refinery intake represents crude only and excludes natural gas liquids, feedstocks and other inputs.
